title: Shechem
lead: A city in the central hills between Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim, near modern Nablus. Abraham's first stop in Canaan, Jacob's purchased field and Joseph's grave, the site of Joshua's covenant renewal, and later the center of the Samaritans (Genesis 12:6; 33:19; Joshua 24; John 4:5).

sections.b: God first promised the land to Abraham at the oak of Moreh at Shechem (Genesis 12:6–7). Jacob bought land there (33:19), and his sons destroyed the city (Genesis 34). Joshua gathered Israel there to renew the covenant (Joshua 24), and Joseph's bones were buried there (Joshua 24:32). Abimelech made himself king there (Judges 9), and Israel's tribes rejected Rehoboam there (1 Kings 12:1–19). Nearby Mount Gerizim became the Samaritans' holy mountain, and Jesus spoke with a Samaritan woman at Jacob's well near Sychar (John 4:5–26).
